title: How Many Bots Can I BEAT with No Queen?
summary: Bot ladder without a queen: player (white) has the full army minus the queen vs chess.com bots of rising Elo until losing. Beats Zach (1), Martin (250), Juan, Noelle (550), Aaron (700), Zara (850), Maria (1000), Laura (1100); loses to Amir/Emir (1200), then wins a revenge game against him (ladder mate); finally loses convincingly to Vin (1300), who trades off all pieces.

Ladder of chess.com bots: Zach 1, Martin 250, Juan (400), Noelle 550, Aaron 700, Zara 850, Maria 1000, Laura 1100, Amir 1200, Vin 1300.
Run ends at the first loss (video counts Amir as a loss, then a bonus revenge win; ends at Vin).
